name: IG Group Holdings plc
summary: IG Group Holdings plc, a fintech company, engages in the online trading and investments business in the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, the United States, Europe, and institutional and emerging markets. The company offers retail over the counter derivatives, including contracts for difference, OTC FX and options; and exchange-traded derivatives options and futures under the tastytrade.
